posts.text: Happy May Day to the people who keep this country going. Today, workers took to the streets demanding that this country put workers over billionaires. Workers are the backbone of this country — and this economy doesn’t work without them. They deserve dignity, fair pay, and time to actually live and thrive, not just survive.

House Republicans kept DHS shut down for over 70 days—cutting off funding for FEMA, TSA, the Coast Guard, and more. Then today, they caved…after accomplishing absolutely nothing.

Just like House Democrats demanded, they funded these agencies without giving ICE another dollar.

So all that chaos? All that harm? For nothing.

Meanwhile, they’ve been playing games with your safety—making life harder and more expensive for you.

Well, well, well… look at that. Just minutes after Oversight Democrats filed a resolution to hold Pam Bondi in contempt for dodging her deposition, Republicans found a way to schedule it.

See you on May 29, Pam.


ABC News Politics (@ABCPolitics)

After a top Democrat introduced a resolution to hold former AG Pam Bondi in civil contempt, a GOP spokesperson for the House Oversight Committee said Bondi will appear on May 29 for a deposition as part of the panel's Jeffrey Epstein investigation. ab

Baby, ain’t nothing nice about ICE.

❌ Killing Americans isn’t “nice.”
❌ Separating children from their families isn't “nice.”
❌ Denying people medical care isn't “nice.”
❌ Terrorizing communities isn’t “nice.”

The political violence is unacceptable and must stop. 

I am grateful that everyone attending tonight’s WHCD is safe.

I am relieved that Hayam El Gamal and her children are finally free after nearly 10 months in detention.

I met with them in January at the Dilley Detention Center, and my heart broke hearing what they went through. Hayam was denied medical care, and her oldest daughter was separated from the family and placed in the women-only section.

Since my visit, my office has stayed in close contact with their attorney and loved ones, pushing ICE and advocating for their release.

They paused Oversight Committee hearings the minute we started getting answers about the Epstein files. 

Now it’s “roundtables”: no rules, no oaths, no subpoenas.

You do the math. Because the moment accountability shows up, they shut it down. The survivors deserve better.

Video

We lost a giant today. Congressman David Scott was a hero to his district, serving the people of the great state of Georgia with immense honor and pride for over two decades.

I had the privilege of serving alongside him on the Agriculture Committee, where he made history for working families across the country.

My heart breaks for his wife and daughters. I'm praying for his loved ones, family, and friends.

Just 36% of Americans approve of the job Trump is doing—and it shows.

Prices are rising, chaos is rising, and Republicans are too busy bowing down to Trump to do a damn thing about it. Not one bill on the House floor this week is focused on lowering costs or making your life more affordable. Not one


NBC News (@NBCNews)

Trump's job rating hits a second-term low as two-thirds of Americans disapprove of his handling of inflation and the Iran war, according to a new NBC News Decision Desk Poll.

In just one day, at least 10 children were killed in horrific shootings in Louisiana and North Carolina. 

Anybody who knows me knows children have my heart. I am heartbroken for these families and the communities now left to carry this pain. These babies had their whole lives ahead of them, and gun violence stole that from them. 

Enough is enough.

Today’s hearing was a purely performative.

Republicans dragged grieving families into a conversation about “sanctuary cities” — knowing full well Congress doesn’t oversee city policy. That’s not our lane.

Our job is to conduct oversight of the federal government. Period.

Instead of doing that, they chose to exploit people’s pain to score political points.

If they actually cared about safety, they’d fix the federal failures they’re responsible for. But they don’t.

Video

Today is Tax Day. So let’s talk about where Donald Trump is spending YOUR tax dollars: his golf trips, his ballroom, his reckless war with Iran, handouts to billionaires, his personal legal fees — and so much more.

Meanwhile, you’re paying more at the pump, at the grocery store, and at the doctor’s office. Make it make sense.

Pam Bondi refused to show up for today’s Oversight deposition — defying our lawful subpoena. 

We couldn’t care less that she was fired from her job as Attorney General. She is responsible for leading the White House cover-up of the Epstein files. 

Since she didn’t show up, Oversight Democrats will move to hold her in contempt of Congress. 

The survivors deserve justice — and we will get answers. Enough is enough.

This week is Black Maternal Health Week — and Black women are still being ignored, dismissed, and disrespected, especially during pregnancy and childbirth.

Over 80% of these deaths didn’t have to happen. This is your reminder to listen to Black women.

Trump and Republicans promised to lower costs on day one. That was a lie.

Trump’s tariffs, his Big Ugly Bill, and his reckless war against Iran are driving prices up everywhere — at the pump, at the grocery store, at the doctor’s office.

Gas prices just hit the biggest monthly spike in decades, jobs are down, and families are paying the price for their failed policies.

Americans have been put last since the day Trump took office. You deserve better.

House Oversight Democrats have been calling for a hearing for months.

Enough with the cover-up. Melania needs to speak with Chairman Comer about making this happen.

The survivors deserve justice.


Julia Manchester (@JuliaManch)

🚨MELANIA TRUMP: "I call on Congress to provide the women who have been victimized by Epstein with a public hearing specifically centered around the survivors."



— https://nitter.net/JuliaManch/status/2042311237434819056#m

If Pam Bondi thinks that she doesn't have to show up and testify before the House Oversight Committee about her cover-up of the Epstein files just because she got fired — she has another thing coming.

We subpoenaed Pam, regardless of her employment status. We expect to see her next week, or she can expect to be held in contempt of Congress. Time is up for these games. The survivors deserve justice, and the American people deserve answers.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

Former Attorney General Pam Bondi

We are watching a dangerous and unfit President drag this country toward catastrophe — and Republicans refuse to act.

Invoke the 25th Amendment. Do your fucking job.
